searchClasses.title: Select your goods and/or services
searchClasses.default_title: What will you use your trademark for?
searchClasses.default_description:
A trademark must be registered in relation to goods and/or services, for example  "software", "clothing", "plumbing", "accounting".

Enter your goods and/or services in the search bar and select the item to be added to your application. You may choose as many as you like. You can select more than one item in each class if needed without incurring additional fees.

Your application can cover more than one "class". For example "computer software" is in class 9 whereas "computer services" are in class 42.

Review and edit your goods and/or services in the sidebar before moving on.
searchClasses.warning_title: TIPS FOR SUCCESS OR NEED SOME HELP FROM OUR EXPERTS?
searchClasses.warning_description:
Trade marks can be rejected for a number of reasons.

TO MINIMISE OBJECTIONS :

AVOID trademarks that describe your goods or services. For example, “DOG COLLAR” for pet accessories. 

AVOID trademarks that too similar to existing trademarks. Even if your EXACT trademark is available, it can be rejected because of similar trademarks.

AVOID trademarks that are images of your product. For example, an image of a candle for "candles".

AVOID common phrases. For example, BREAK A LEG for "entertainment services". 

AVOID geographical names. For example, New South Wales.

NEED TO TALK TO AN EXPERT? Get in touch
